fieldissues.issue: The title ends after “against DHS secretary Kristi” and is incomplete.

Several tags are arbitrary fragments from the title, and Robin Kelly is duplicated in topic_tags and people_tags.
The House and Department of Homeland Security are central to the account but are not tagged.

proposedchanges.change: Use “Rep. Robin Kelly files impeachment articles against DHS Secretary Kristi Noem after Renee Good shooting.”
Replace “Threats / Incitement” with a subject label such as “DHS oversight and impeachment proceedings.”
Remove title fragments and Robin Kelly; retain “Kristi Noem impeachment,” “Renee Good shooting,” “DHS oversight,” and “ICE enforcement.”
Add the U.S. House of Representatives and the U.S. Department of Homeland Security.

evidencebasis: The packet says Representative Robin Kelly filed articles of impeachment after Renee Good’s killing.
The merged descriptions discuss allegations in the filing and explain that no House finding or Senate conviction had occurred.

fieldissues.issue: “Substantial participation by overseas investors and concern from ethics critics” is an unfinished sentence fragment.

The two tags are broad and omit the event’s access and foreign-purchase subjects.

proposedchanges.change: Replace the fragment with a complete sentence and attribute the foreign-participant estimate to the wallet analysis; distinguish appearance of foreign status from confirmed nationality.
Use “Trump’s memecoin contest offers dinner and White House tour to top holders; wallet analysis suggests foreign winners.”
Add specific subjects such as “presidential access,” “$TRUMP token contest,” and “foreign-purchase concerns.”

evidencebasis: The packet says 158 of 220 winners appeared foreign based on exchange usage patterns and describes the dinner and tour as prizes for top token holders.
The merged medium contains a sentence fragment and says overseas participation was substantial without completing the claim.
notes: The description should attribute the estimate and avoid treating exchange patterns as confirmed nationality or proof of illegal contributions.

Add the Mawson paper and the epidemiological assessments supporting the methodological criticisms, or remove those details from the long.
Attribute criticism of the cited paper and separate it clearly from the retracted Wakefield study; remove the unsupported claim about Kennedy’s intent.
